## Player problem
<!-- What is difficult, unclear or unrewarding? Separate observed evidence from hypotheses. -->

## Desired experience
<!-- What should the player see, understand and feel? Include acceptance criteria. -->

## Design decisions
<!-- Settled intent and constraints. Distinguish proposals from explicit approval; link sources. -->

## Open questions
<!-- Only unresolved questions that materially affect the product. Name deferred scope. -->

## Engineering response
<!-- Claude comments: inspected branch/SHA, material constraints, options, tradeoffs, recommendation. Link the comment here if useful. -->

## Owner decision
<!-- Link explicit owner approval and its scope. Pending until recorded; never infer approval. -->

## Implementation
<!-- Claude comments: branch, full SHA/PR, delivered scope, actual test commands/results, failures and untested areas. -->

## Review
<!-- Findings against a specific SHA, accepted fixes, verification and owner acceptance. -->
